summary: Adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method to Order. Adds order detail and discount redeem endpoints with their URL routes.

findings.title: Order detail lookup ignores the owner
findings.problem: order_detail fetches the order by primary key alone and never checks that request.user owns it. The sibling redeem view filters on owner=request.user, but order_detail does not.
findings.consequence: Any logged-in user can read every other customer's order total and discount code by stepping through order ids.
findings.fix: Add owner=request.user to the get_object_or_404 lookup, as redeem already does.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float raises TypeError
findings.problem: The total field holds a Decimal, and apply_discount multiplies it by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError when it multiplies a Decimal by a float.
findings.consequence: Every valid WELCOME10 redemption crashes with a server error, so no customer can get the discount.
findings.fix: Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and round the result to two decimal places.

findings.title: New field has no migration
findings.problem: The change adds the discount_code field to Order but adds no migration. The only migration, 0001_initial.py, does not create the discount_code column.
findings.consequence: Every Order query fails with a missing column error after deploy, which breaks order_list as well as the new views.
findings.fix: Run makemigrations and commit the new migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on a session-authenticated POST
findings.problem: redeem changes order state and relies on the session cookie through login_required. The csrf_exempt decorator turns off the CsrfViewMiddleware check that settings enable.
findings.consequence: A third-party site can make a logged-in user's browser redeem a code on that user's order without the user's consent.
findings.fix: Remove csrf_exempt and have clients send the CSRF token with the POST.

findings.title: New discount and view behaviour has no tests
findings.problem: The change adds apply_discount, order_detail and redeem, but the repository has no tests for any of them.
findings.consequence: The Decimal crash and the missing ownership check reached review because no test exercises these paths.
findings.fix: Add tests for discount redemption, repeat redemption, and access to another user's order.
